situations.headline: Perennial Better Future Active ETF (IMPQ) to wind up and delist from ASX

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Perennial Better Future Active ETF (IMPQ) to wind up and delist from ASX (interest 2, risk 2)

thesis.text: IMPQ is a sub-scale active ETF being voluntarily wound up by its Responsible Entity due to lack of economic viability at scale; the situation is a mechanical NAV-realization wind-up with no apparent arbitrage or contested angle, and the ticker will cease to exist post-deregistration, limiting future relevance for the file.
